method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. A layer beside baseline-2026-10, which is unchanged. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Liability Act 2002 (WA) (No. 35 of 2002), compilation as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49335.txt (legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc 49335, retrieved 2026-09-07), with Part 2A (No. 3 of 2018, in operation 1 July 2018; s 15L as amended by No. 9 of 2022) and Part 2 Division 5 (No. 32 of 2024, in operation 1 December 2024); no regulations: none is deposited, and whether a s 15G(5) regulation names a successor is an input
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual bringing the claim: the person sexually abused as a child (Part 2A), the person with a dust disease (Part 2 Division 5), the injured person (s 13A, Part 2 Division 4)

cla2-abuse.l4: Whom can I sue for abuse in an institution that was unincorporated
Can my judgment or settlement be paid from the institution's assets and trusts
Can the office holder's personal assets be used to pay me
How much of an earlier payment is deducted from my damages
How much will I be awarded after the deduction
How much of my legal fees can I get back
cla2-dust.l4: Is my condition a dust disease
Can I be awarded provisional damages
Can I bring a subsequent action for a later dust disease
Does my settlement agreement say what the Act requires
What happens to my settled dust disease action
What earlier amounts count against my subsequent damages
cla2-care.l4: Can I be awarded damages for my care needs in the CISS
Can the court approve my structured settlement

checks.command: l4 run cla2-abuse-cases.l4; l4 run cla2-dust-cases.l4; l4 run cla2-care-cases.l4; l4 run on each module
checks.result: cla2-abuse-cases.l4: 51 of 51 satisfied; cla2-dust-cases.l4: 46 of 46; cla2-care-cases.l4: 25 of 25; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A negative control (three altered expected values) gave three failures.

scope: Part 2A (ss 15A-15L: whom to sue when the institution was unincorporated, ss 15A, 15B, 15D, 15F-15I; assets for judgments and settlements, ss 15C, 15E; prior compensation payments, s 15K; caps on legal fees, s 15L); Part 2 Division 5 (ss 15AA-15AO: dust disease, provisional damages, subsequent actions, settlement agreements, s 15AK); s 13A (CISS); Part 2 Division 4 (ss 14-15); s 3A and s 6(4) so far as they reach Divisions 3-5. Out: s 15J, s 15M, s 15G(5)-(7) as a power, s 15AD, s 15AH(3)-(7), s 15AI, s 15AN; everything baseline-2026-10 covers; Parts 1B-1F, Part 1A Division 7, Part 3.
